Suspected aerial objects prompt NATO response in Utena County, Lithuania

21 May 2026 · Utena County

Suspected-object cluster

On 21 May 2026 two suspected aerial objects were detected in the airspace over Utena County, Lithuania. Warnings were issued and NATO aircraft were reported to have responded.

It has not been definitively established that the objects were drones (UAVs), or that they came from abroad. Findings on the individual objects were not available, and their route was not specified.

No physical harm was reported. The detection is treated as a single incident involving two objects, not as two confirmed foreign-drone incursions.
